component.name: Photo Scan
component.summary: Scan documents and photos with SANE

description.p: Photo Scan is a simple Qt6 desktop app for SANE scanners on Linux. It helps you scan documents and photographs with automatic photo detection and cropping.

ul.li: Discover USB, network, and AirScan/eSCL scanners
Pro mode with full SANE options, preview, and area selection
Automatically detect and crop multiple photos from one scan
Scan to your chosen folder with automatic file numbering
